fact: A World Bank mission of 6-12 September 2025 found PFM Smart operational only in Freetown City Council, with roll-out to all 22 local councils targeted for January 2026 and dependent on internet connectivity and solar panels still to be put in place.
title: Sierra Leone Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery (P172492), Credit No. IDA-D8380, Project Implementation Support Mission (ISM) Aide-Memoire, September 6-12, 2025
